# Prissy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** sixteen  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Prissy Andrews has a beautiful complexion and curly brown hair. She styles her hair in an elegant, swept-up fashion.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Prissy Andrews is a student focused on her academic pursuits. She is currently motivated by her preparation for the Queen's entrance examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)_

## History

Prissy Andrews was a student under the instruction of schoolmaster Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). Her time under his tutelage came to an end when Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) departed from the school.

## Relationships

### [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Prissy Andrews is courted by her schoolteacher, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). Their romantic involvement is a noted point of interest in the school community up until Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) leaves his teaching position. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on his eventual departure while recounting local news to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
